name: prepare_regenie_olink_inputs
title: Prepare regenie Olink inputs
summary: Format proteomics levels and covariates parquets into regenie-ready text files.

inputSpec.name: raw_covariates
inputSpec.label: Raw covariates CSV
inputSpec.help: Raw covariates CSV exported from table-exporter (samples x UKB fields).

inputSpec.name: covariate_mapping
inputSpec.label: Covariate field mapping parquet
inputSpec.help: Parquet mapping UKB codes to field names and titles (olink_covariate_field_mapping.parquet).

inputSpec.name: proteomics_levels
inputSpec.label: Proteomics levels CSV
inputSpec.help: CSV file of proteomics levels exported from table-exporter.

outputSpec.name: regenie_covariates
outputSpec.label: Regenie covariates
outputSpec.help: Tab-separated covariates file for regenie (FID, IID, covariates).

outputSpec.name: regenie_levels
outputSpec.label: Regenie phenotype levels
outputSpec.help: Tab-separated phenotype file for regenie (FID, IID, proteins).

outputSpec.name: regenie_samples
outputSpec.label: Regenie sample list
outputSpec.help: Tab-separated sample list for regenie (FID, IID).
